mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT d.contentid, d.title, d.addr1, d.firstimage2, s.SIGNGU_NAME AS regionName, ROWNUM AS rn FROM ( SELECT * FROM destination WHERE LOWER(title) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(addr1) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' ORDER BY contentid asc ) d LEFT JOIN ldong_signgu_code s ON d.lDongRegnCd = s.LDONGREGNCD AND d.lDongSignguCd = s.LDONGSIGNGUCD WHERE ROWNUM <= #{offset} + #{limit} ) WHERE rn > #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM destination WHERE LOWER(title) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(addr1) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%'

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT p.pln_id AS plnId, p.pln_title AS plnTitle, p.start_date AS startDate, p.end_date AS endDate, p.total_days AS totalDays, s.SIGNGU_NAME AS regionName, ROWNUM AS rn FROM ( SELECT * FROM planner WHERE LOWER(pln_title) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' AND is_public = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC ) p LEFT JOIN ldong_signgu_code s ON p.lDongRegnCd = s.LDONGREGNCD AND p.lDongSignguCd = s.LDONGSIGNGUCD WHERE ROWNUM <= #{offset} + #{limit} ) WHERE rn > #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM planner WHERE LOWER(pln_title) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' AND is_public = 1
